notes.curves: Raw periodic evaluation, no smoothing or seed mixing.
notes.diagnostics: Arithmetic mean of logged wave metrics in 50,000-game bins; last bin may be partial.
notes.omissions: Per-deck pair arrays omitted; original per-policy uncertainty summaries retained.
notes.cuda_status: Incomplete suite; final tests exist only for seed 42.

learning_analysis.rule: Final common checkpoint window; each seed range <= delta and the 95% seed t interval of late-half minus early-half means lies inside [-delta,+delta]. At least 3 seeds. Descriptive only; does not stop training or establish convergence.
learning_analysis.alignment: Linear interpolation within common observed support per algorithm for time/decisions; no extrapolation. Games use common measured checkpoints. No smoothing.
learning_analysis.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% Student-t interval across training seeds; not simultaneous bands or deck-level intervals.
learning_analysis.time: Pure training seconds, excluding evaluation, report writing and checkpoint I/O.

protocol.evaluation: paired decks, sampled PPO/NFSP, greedy DQN; both NFSP/DQN policies averaged
protocol.limits: Finite baseline performance is not exploitability/NashConv or a convergence proof.
